tsa-a05-v01.quick_english: When the concept can by itself impress the self, independent of other means — fallen from bonded activity, by grace of pure knowledge, having attained Lord-power-form, relied on as means, it brings forth śākta knowledge.

tsa-a05-v02.quick_english: This is settled in the very next ahnika.

tsa-a05-v03.quick_english: When the concept depends on another means for its own impression — taking mind, breath, body, pot etc. as limited-formed means, reaching subtlety, it brings forth āṇava knowledge. Therein: mind is meditation-natured; breath gross and subtle — first, articulation-natured; articulation is the five prāṇa-functions; the subtle is denoted by letter-sound, to be said later; body is arrangement-specific, denoted by instrument-sound; pots etc. external, to be praised as means by pot-pit-liṅga-worship.

tsa-a05-v04.quick_english: Here the fitting meditation is taught: the self-luminous supreme tattva contained in all tattvas — meditating it in own-heart-knowing, let him meditate the union of knower-instrument-known, the fire-sun-moon triad, until he becomes great-Bhairava-fire, meditation-wind-fanned. From its wheel wrapped by twelve old power-flames, emerging by some pore-door, let him contemplate it having rested in the external graspable-self; by that rested one, first filled external by moon-form in creation-order, then illuminated by sun-form, then dissolved by dissolution-fire, then caused unsurpassable-selfhood — let him meditate.

tsa-a05-v05.quick_english: Thus that wheel becomes complete with all external-thing-divisions.

tsa-a05-v06.quick_english: Then with that wheel let him meditate the residual habit-states made thus.

tsa-a05-v07.quick_english: For this unceasing meditator, determining own-consciousness-merely-real series of creation-preservation-dissolution and creation-autonomy-supremacy from own-consciousness — at once Bhairava-state.

tsa-a05-v08.quick_english: By practice, all desired attainments and rest too.

tsa-a05-v10.quick_english: Having entered, standing, let him meditate in the heart-bliss-abode.

tsa-a05-v12.quick_english: Emerging by ethers outside, let him meditate it bearing creation-and-rest-states.

tsa-a05-v13.quick_english: That mandala swallowing all outer-inner being — in self.

tsa-a05-v14.quick_english: Resting, let the yogin contemplate — thus the spread of self.

tsa-a05-v17.quick_english: When about to articulate breath: first he rests in heart-emptiness; then outside from breath-arising; then toward external by moon-filling of apāna, seeing all-selfness; then desiring no other; from samāna-arising experiencing union-rest; from udāna-fire-arising grasping the measure-measured-and-rest construction.

tsa-a05-v18.quick_english: In its swallowing-fire pacification, vyāna-arising, devoid of all limitation, it flashes.

tsa-a05-v19.quick_english: Thus from emptiness up to vyāna — these rests: own-bliss, without-bliss, supreme-bliss, brahman-bliss, great-bliss, consciousness-bliss — six bliss-levels taught; of which one connector, without arising-setting, inner-rest-truth-form, world-bliss.

tsa-a05-v20.quick_english: Therefore in these articulation-levels, resting each-separately two-and-rest-wise or wholly, he makes attain rest-tattva apart from that body-breath-rest.

tsa-a05-v21.quick_english: That very secret of creation-dissolution-seed-articulation, keeping in mind, let him impress the concept; and in these rests each-separately five states become, from depth-of-entry.

tsa-a05-v22.quick_english: Therein first bliss, from contact of fullness-portion; then arising, a moment, in embodimentlessness of the accustomed; then tremor, from self-power-overpowering, loosening body-identity; then sleep, from dissolution of outwardness.

tsa-a05-v23.quick_english: Thus non-self-being dissolved in self-being: from all-pervasiveness, non-self-being dissolves in self — therefore whirling, from arising of great-pervasion.

tsa-a05-v24.quick_english: These are the waking-and-rest levels, beyond-fourth-to-limit.

tsa-a05-v25.quick_english: And these levels occur in entry of the triangle-root-heart-pace-upward-kuṇḍalinī-wheel.

tsa-a05-v26.quick_english: Thus in articulation-rest: what supreme pulsation, dissolved-rest-knowable; what dawning knowable; what already-dawned knowable — that triad of marks we will say at the proper time.

tsa-a05-v27.quick_english: And the supreme mark here: the yogini-heart.

tsa-a05-v28.quick_english: Therein primary pulsation-form, by contraction-expansion-nature, pair-form-arising, from gaining visarga-portion-rest — enough.

tsa-a05-v30.quick_english: First in own-knowing, then in the knowable resting, let him complete the knowable.

tsa-a05-v31.quick_english: In the complete, here he rests — the measurer-measured distinction; quickly let him withdraw.

tsa-a05-v32.quick_english: Having pervaded, then he rests; those would be with emptiness, the six-means-levels.

tsa-a05-v33.quick_english: Breath-and-rest: not-after-vyāna; and dissolved-in-it: waking from the beginning, manifestation.

tsa-a05-v34.quick_english: Established-in-practice here, in the creation-dissolution-contemplation-abode, let him grow before long.

tsa-a05-v37.quick_english: In this articulation flashing: sound, letter — almost-imitation-of-unmanifest; its primary form in the creation-dissolution-seed — from its practice, gain of supreme-consciousness. For instance: in kā, at the end of mā, in sācke, in anacke, or inner-articulated, remembered — equally-distinguished consciousness-pulsation-touch, from disregard-of-convention complete; even for convention-regarders, words producing its meaning like a mirage and rest; from unsurpassable-consciousness-touch, unified heart-throat-lips, twelve-end-pair and heart let him unify — letter-secret.

tsa-a05-v38.quick_english: Born immediately after inner-touch-contemplation: the white-yellow-and-rest inner letter, being manifested, consciousness causes to experience — so some say.

tsa-a05-v39.quick_english: By absence of the expressible, from consciousness-pulsation, by the moon-sun-motion checks.

tsa-a05-v40.quick_english: Of which, by equal entry, complete in consciousness-seed-mass-letter-form.

tsa-a05-v43.quick_english: The operation of mudrā-revelation we will say.

tsa-a05-v01.speaker: Teacher (dhyāna-uccāra-varṇa doctrine)
tsa-a05-v01.question: When does vikalpa itself become the upāya?
premises: yadā vikalpaḥ svayam eva saṃskāram ātmani kartuṃ prabhavati — when concept can itself impress the self.
upāyāntaranirapekṣatayā — independent of other means.
pāśavavyāpārāt pracutaḥ, śuddhavidyānugraheṇa parameśaśaktirūpatām āpannaḥ — fallen from bonded activity, by pure-knowledge grace attaining Lord-power-form.
upāyatayā avalambyamānaḥ śāktaṃ jñānam āvirbhāvayati — relied on as means, it brings forth śākta knowledge.
tsa-a05-v01.inference: Self-powered vikalpa = the śākta upāya: no external instrument, power-form as the means itself.

tsa-a05-v02.speaker: Teacher (dhyāna-uccāra-varṇa doctrine)
tsa-a05-v02.question: Where is this settled?
premises: tad etac ca nirṇītam anantara eva āhnike — settled in the very next ahnika.
tsa-a05-v02.inference: Cross-reference only: the proof lives ahead, not here.

tsa-a05-v03.speaker: Teacher (dhyāna-uccāra-varṇa doctrine)
tsa-a05-v03.question: What happens when vikalpa depends on another means?
premises: yadā tu upāyāntaram asau svasaṃskārārtham vikalpo 'pekṣate — when it depends on another means for own impression.
buddhiprāṇadehaghaṭādikān parimitarūpān upāyatvena gṛhṇan — taking mind/breath/body/pot as limited means.
aṇutvaṃ prāpta āṇavaṃ jñānam āvirbhāvayati — reaching subtlety, it brings forth āṇava knowledge.
buddhiḥ dhyānātmikā, prāṇaḥ sthūlaḥ sūkṣmaś ca, dehaḥ saṃniveśaviśeṣātmā, ghaṭādayaḥ bāhyāḥ — the means typed: meditation-mind, gross/subtle breath, arranged body, external pots.
tsa-a05-v03.inference: Instrument-dependent vikalpa = the āṇava upāya: each means limited-form, each typed by its sound (varṇa/karaṇa/ghaṭa).

tsa-a05-v04.speaker: Teacher (dhyāna-uccāra-varṇa doctrine)
tsa-a05-v04.question: What is the dhyāna taught here?
premises: svaprakāśaṃ sarvatattvāntarbhūtaṃ paraṃ tattvam — the self-luminous supreme tattva in all tattvas.
nijahṛdayabodhe dhyātvā — meditated in own-heart-knowing.
pramātṛpramāṇaprameyarūpasya vahnyarkasomatritayasya saṃghaṭṭaṃ dhyāyet — union of knower-instrument-known, fire-sun-moon triad.
yāvat asau mahābhairavāgniḥ dhyānavātasamiddhākāraḥ sampadyate — until great-Bhairava-fire, meditation-wind-fanned.
cakrātmanaḥ suṣiradvāreṇa niḥsṛtasya bāhye grāhyātmani viśrāntaṃ cintayet — the wheel-emergent rests in external graspable-self.
somarūpatayā sṛṣṭi, arkarūpatayā sthiti, saṃhāravahnirūpatayā vilāpa, anuttarātmatām āpāditaṃ dhyāyet — four-fillings: moon-creation, sun-preservation, fire-dissolution, anuttara-selfhood.
tsa-a05-v04.inference: The dhyāna is triadic-union plus four-stage cosmic filling — meditation ends where anuttara-selfhood is caused.

tsa-a05-v05.speaker: Teacher (dhyāna-uccāra-varṇa doctrine)
tsa-a05-v05.question: What does the wheel become?
premises: evaṃ tac cakraṃ samastabāhyavastvabhedaparipūrṇaṃ sampadyate — complete with all external-thing divisions.
tsa-a05-v05.inference: Completion criterion: the wheel holds every bāhya-vastu-bheda.

tsa-a05-v06.speaker: Teacher (dhyāna-uccāra-varṇa doctrine)
tsa-a05-v06.question: What is meditated with that wheel?
premises: tato vāsanāśeṣān api bhāvān tena cakreṇa itthaṃ kṛtān dhyāyet — residual habit-states, made thus, with that wheel.
tsa-a05-v06.inference: Vāsanā-cleanup rides the same cakra: residue-states included, not excluded.

tsa-a05-v07.speaker: Teacher (dhyāna-uccāra-varṇa doctrine)
tsa-a05-v07.question: What does the unceasing meditator gain at once?
premises: anavarataṃ dhyāyinaḥ svasaṃvinmātraparamārthān sṛṣṭisthitisaṃhāraprabandhān — own-consciousness-merely-real series of creation-preservation-dissolution.
sṛṣṭyādisvātantryaparamārthatvaṃ ca svasaṃvido niścinvataḥ — determining creation-autonomy-supremacy from own consciousness.
sadya eva bhairavībhāvaḥ — at once Bhairava-state.
tsa-a05-v07.inference: Bhairava-bhāva is immediate (sadya), not gradual — the reward of niścaya on saṃvid grounds.

tsa-a05-v08.speaker: Teacher (dhyāna-uccāra-varṇa doctrine)
tsa-a05-v08.question: What does practice yield?
premises: abhyāsāt tu sarvepsitasiddhyādayo 'pi — by practice, all desired attainments and rest.
tsa-a05-v08.inference: Siddhis ride abhyāsa — subordinate, listed without elaboration.

tsa-a05-v09.speaker: Teacher (dhyāna-uccāra-varṇa doctrine)
tsa-a05-v09.question: What triad is placed antaḥ?
premises: svaprakāśaṃ samastātmatattvaṃ mātrādikaṃ trayam — self-luminous all-self-tattva, measure-and-rest triad.
tsa-a05-v09.inference: The triad = svaprakāśa + samastātma-tattva + mātrādi: the content of inward placement.

tsa-a05-v10.speaker: Teacher (dhyāna-uccāra-varṇa doctrine)
tsa-a05-v10.question: Where does the meditator stand?
premises: antaḥkṛtya sthitaṃ dhyāyed dhṛdayānandadhāmani — having entered, standing, meditate in heart-bliss-abode.
tsa-a05-v10.inference: The locus is dhṛdaya-ānanda-dhāman: entry, stance, meditation in one clause.

tsa-a05-v11.speaker: Teacher (dhyāna-uccāra-varṇa doctrine)
tsa-a05-v11.question: What is that object?
premises: tad dvādaśamahāśaktiraśmicakreśvaraṃ vibhum — the twelve-great-power-ray-wheel-Lord, all-pervading.

tsa-a05-v12.speaker: Teacher (dhyāna-uccāra-varṇa doctrine)
tsa-a05-v12.question: How is it seen outside?
premises: vyomabhir niḥsarad bāhye dhyāyet sṛṣṭyādibhāvakam — emerging by ethers outside, meditate it bearing creation-states.
tsa-a05-v12.inference: Vyomadhāra carries the cakra outward as sṛṣṭy-ādi-bhāva-kam.

tsa-a05-v13.speaker: Teacher (dhyāna-uccāra-varṇa doctrine)
tsa-a05-v13.question: What mandala is placed in self?
premises: tad grastasarvabāhyāntarbhāvamaṇḍalam ātmani — that swallowing all outer-inner being mandala, in self.
tsa-a05-v13.inference: Placement reverses the outward flow: the grasta-maṇḍala rests in ātman.

tsa-a05-v14.speaker: Teacher (dhyāna-uccāra-varṇa doctrine)
tsa-a05-v14.question: What does the yogin thereby become?
premises: viśrāmyan bhāvayed yogī syād evam ātmanaḥ prathā — resting, contemplating, the yogin becomes the spread of self.
tsa-a05-v14.inference: The result is prathā of ātman: rest-then-contemplate, identity-as-spread.

tsa-a05-v15.speaker: Teacher (dhyāna-uccāra-varṇa doctrine)
tsa-a05-v15.question: What closes the dhyāna section?
premises: iti saṃgrahaślokāḥ — these are the summary-verses.
tsa-a05-v15.inference: Colophon: the preceding four (u9-14) are saṃgraha-ślokas in verse form.

tsa-a05-v16.speaker: Teacher (dhyāna-uccāra-varṇa doctrine)
tsa-a05-v16.question: What section ends here?
premises: iti dhyānam — thus meditation.

tsa-a05-v17.speaker: Teacher (dhyāna-uccāra-varṇa doctrine)
tsa-a05-v17.question: What is the prāṇa-uccāra sequence?
premises: prāṇam uccicārayiṣuḥ pūrvam hṛdaya eva śūnye viśrāmyati — first rests in heart-emptiness.
tato bāhye prāṇodayāt — then outside from breath-arising.
tato 'pi bāhyaṃ prati apānacandrāpūraṇena sarvātmatāṃ paśyati — then toward external by apāna-moon-filling, seeing all-selfness.
tataḥ anyanirākāṅkṣo bhavati — then desiring no other.
tataḥ samānodayāt saṃghaṭṭaviśrāntim anubhavati — from samāna-arising, union-rest.
tata udānavahnyudaye mātṛmeyādikalanāṃ grasate — from udāna-fire, the measure-measured construction.
tsa-a05-v17.inference: Six-stage articulation: hṛdaya-śūnya → prāṇodaya → apāna-candra → anya-nirākāṅkṣā → samāna-saṃghaṭṭa → udāna-kalanā.

tsa-a05-v18.speaker: Teacher (dhyāna-uccāra-varṇa doctrine)
tsa-a05-v18.question: What flashes at vyāna?
premises: tadgrāsakavahnipraśame vyānodaye sarvāvacchedavandhyaḥ sphurati — at swallowing-fire pacification, vyāna-arising, devoid of all limitation, it flashes.
tsa-a05-v18.inference: Vyāna = the unbounded flash (sarvāvaccheda-vandhya), seventh moment of the sequence.

tsa-a05-v19.speaker: Teacher (dhyāna-uccāra-varṇa doctrine)
tsa-a05-v19.question: What six bliss-levels are taught?
premises: śūnyāt prabhṛti vyānāntam — from emptiness to vyāna.
nijānandaḥ nirānandaḥ parānandaḥ brahmānandaḥ mahānandaḥ cidānanda iti ṣaṭ ānandabhūmayaḥ — six levels named.
yāsām ekaḥ anusaṃdhātā udayāstamayavihīnaḥ antarviśrāntiparamārtharūpo jagadānandaḥ — one connector without arising-setting, inner-rest-truth-form: world-bliss.
tsa-a05-v19.inference: Six bhūmis plus a seventh (jagad-ānanda) that unites them as the connector beyond rise-and-set.

tsa-a05-v20.speaker: Teacher (dhyāna-uccāra-varṇa doctrine)
tsa-a05-v20.question: What is attained in the uccāra-bhūmis?
premises: etāsu uccārabhūmiṣu pratyekaṃ dvyādiśaḥ sarvaśo vā viśramya — resting each two-wise or wholly in articulation-levels.
anyat taddehaprāṇādivyatiriktaṃ viśrāntitattvam āsādayati — attains rest-tattva apart from body-breath.
tsa-a05-v20.inference: Rest-position determines attainment: viśrānti-tattva, distinct from body-prāṇa, is the uccāra-bhūmi prize.

tsa-a05-v21.speaker: Teacher (dhyāna-uccāra-varṇa doctrine)
tsa-a05-v21.question: What secret is kept in mind, and how many states per rest?
premises: tad eva sṛṣṭisaṃhārabījoccāraṇarahasyam anusaṃdadhat vikalpaṃ saṃskuryāt — keep the creation-dissolution-seed-articulation secret, impress the concept.
āsu ca viśrāntiṣu pratyekaṃ pañca avasthā bhavanti praveśatāratamyāt — in rests, five states each, by depth-of-entry.
tsa-a05-v21.inference: The bīja-rahasya governs uccāra; each viśrānti carries five avasthās scaled by entry-depth.

tsa-a05-v22.speaker: Teacher (dhyāna-uccāra-varṇa doctrine)
tsa-a05-v22.question: What are those states in the first rest?
premises: prāg ānandaḥ pūrṇatāṃśasparśāt — first bliss, from fullness-portion contact.
tata udbhavaḥ kṣaṇaṃ niḥśarīratāyāṃ rūḍheḥ — then arising, a moment, in embodimentlessness of the accustomed.
tataḥ kampaḥ svabalākrāntau dehatādātmyaśaithilyāt — then tremor, self-power-overpowering, loosening body-identity.
tato nidrā bahirmukhatvavilayāt — then sleep, from dissolution of outwardness.
tsa-a05-v22.inference: Four named states here (ānanda, udbhava, kampa, nidrā) — the fifth (ghūrṇi) arrives in the next verse.

tsa-a05-v23.speaker: Teacher (dhyāna-uccāra-varṇa doctrine)
tsa-a05-v23.question: What is the fifth state?
premises: ittham anātmani ātmabhāve līne — non-self-being dissolved in self-being.
svātmanaḥ sarvamayatvāt ātmani anātmabhāvo vilīyate — from all-pervasiveness, the non-self dissolves in self.
ato ghūrṇiḥ mahāvyāptyudayāt — therefore whirling, from arising of great-pervasion.
tsa-a05-v23.inference: Ghūrṇi completes the pañca-avasthā: dissolution-of-non-self into sarvamaya ātman.

tsa-a05-v24.speaker: Teacher (dhyāna-uccāra-varṇa doctrine)
tsa-a05-v24.question: What levels are these?
premises: tā etā jāgradādibhūmayaḥ turyātītāntāḥ — these are waking-and-rest levels, beyond-fourth-to-limit.
tsa-a05-v24.inference: The five states span jāgrad to turyātīta: the full bhūmi-range.

tsa-a05-v25.speaker: Teacher (dhyāna-uccāra-varṇa doctrine)
tsa-a05-v25.question: Where do these levels occur?
premises: etāś ca bhūmayaḥ trikoṇakandahṛttālūrdhvakuṇḍalinīcakrapraveśe bhavanti — they occur in entry of triangle-root-heart-pace-upward-kuṇḍalinī-wheel.
tsa-a05-v25.inference: Locative map: the bhūmis live at the kuṇḍalinī-cakra entry-points named in the compound.

tsa-a05-v26.speaker: Teacher (dhyāna-uccāra-varṇa doctrine)
tsa-a05-v26.question: What is the triad of liṅgas in uccāra-rest?
premises: uccāraviśrāntau yat paraṃ spandanaṃ galitāśeṣavedyaṃ — supreme pulsation, dissolved-rest-knowable.
yac ca unmiṣad vedyaṃ — dawning knowable.
yac ca unmiṣitavedyaṃ — already-dawned knowable.
tat eva liṅgam iti vakṣyāmaḥ svāvasare — that triad of marks we will say at the proper time.
tsa-a05-v26.inference: Three liṅgas: para-spandana (past-dissolved), unmiṣat (present-dawning), unmiṣita (already-dawned) — deferred exposition.

tsa-a05-v27.speaker: Teacher (dhyāna-uccāra-varṇa doctrine)
tsa-a05-v27.question: What is the supreme liṅga here?
premises: paraṃ cātra liṅgaṃ yoginīhṛdayam — the supreme mark here: yogini-heart.
tsa-a05-v27.inference: Yoginī-hṛdaya = para-liṅga of the uccāra system.

tsa-a05-v28.speaker: Teacher (dhyāna-uccāra-varṇa doctrine)
tsa-a05-v28.question: What is the primary spanda-rūpatā?
premises: mukhyā spandanarūpatā saṃkocavikāsātmatayā — primary pulsation-form, contraction-expansion-natured.
yāmalarūpatodayena — by pair-form arising.
visargakalāviśrāntilābhāt — from gaining visarga-portion-rest.
ity alam — enough.
tsa-a05-v28.inference: Spanda = saṃkoca-vikāsa as yāmala-pair, reaching visarga-kalā; the section stops here (alam).

tsa-a05-v29.speaker: Teacher (dhyāna-uccāra-varṇa doctrine)
tsa-a05-v29.question: What kind of entry is this?
premises: aprakāśaḥ atra anupraveśaḥ — non-luminous: here entry.
tsa-a05-v29.inference: This anupraveśa is aprakāśa: entry without manifestation — a marked distinction.

tsa-a05-v30.speaker: Teacher (dhyāna-uccāra-varṇa doctrine)
tsa-a05-v30.question: What is the order of completion?
premises: pūrvam svabodhe — first in own-knowing.
tadanu prameye viśramya — then resting in the knowable.
meyaṃ paripūrayeta — let him complete the knowable.
tsa-a05-v30.inference: svabodha → prameya-viśrānti → meya-paripūraṇa: knowing first, object completed last.

tsa-a05-v31.speaker: Teacher (dhyāna-uccāra-varṇa doctrine)
tsa-a05-v31.question: What happens at completion?
premises: pūrṇe 'tra viśrāmyati mātṛmeyavibhāgam — in the complete, here he rests: the measurer-measured distinction.
āśv eva sa saṃhareta — quickly let him withdraw.
tsa-a05-v31.inference: Rest at pūrṇa holds the mātṛ-meya-bheda; withdrawal is swift (āśu) — no lingering.

tsa-a05-v32.speaker: Teacher (dhyāna-uccāra-varṇa doctrine)
tsa-a05-v32.question: What are the six means-levels?
premises: vyāptyātha viśrāmyati — having pervaded, then he rests.
tā imāḥ syuḥ śūnyena sākaṃ ṣaḍupāyabhūmyaḥ — those would be with emptiness: the six means-levels.
tsa-a05-v32.inference: Ṣaḍ-upāya-bhūmis stand with śūnya: pervasion-rest is their condition.

tsa-a05-v33.speaker: Teacher (dhyāna-uccāra-varṇa doctrine)
tsa-a05-v33.question: What is prāṇa's position among the levels?
premises: prāṇādayo vyānanapaścimās — breath-and-rest are not-after-vyāna.
tallīnaś ca jāgrat prabhṛti prapañcaḥ — dissolved-in-it: waking-from-beginning manifestation.
tsa-a05-v33.inference: Prāṇa-ādis follow vyāna and are dissolved in it — the manifest series (jāgrat onward) rides that order.

tsa-a05-v34.speaker: Teacher (dhyāna-uccāra-varṇa doctrine)
tsa-a05-v34.question: What grows for the abhyāsa-niṣṭha?
premises: abhyāsaniṣṭho 'tra tu sṛṣṭisaṃhṛdvimarśadhāmany acireṇa rohet — established-in-practice here, in creation-dissolution-contemplation-abode, grows before long.
tsa-a05-v34.inference: Abhyāsa-niṣṭha grows (rohati) in the vimarśa-dhāman — growth, not acquisition.

tsa-a05-v35.speaker: Teacher (dhyāna-uccāra-varṇa doctrine)
tsa-a05-v35.question: What closes this inner section?
premises: iti āntaraślokāḥ — these are the inner-verses.

tsa-a05-v36.speaker: Teacher (dhyāna-uccāra-varṇa doctrine)
tsa-a05-v36.question: What section ends?
premises: iti uccāraṇam — thus articulation.

tsa-a05-v37.speaker: Teacher (dhyāna-uccāra-varṇa doctrine)
tsa-a05-v37.question: What is the varṇa-rahasya of this uccāra?
premises: asmin eva uccāre sphuran avyaktānukṛtiprāyo dhvaniḥ varṇaḥ — in this articulation flashes sound-letter, almost-imitation-of-unmanifest.
tasya sṛṣṭisaṃhārabīje mukhyaṃ rūpaṃ — its primary form in the creation-dissolution-seed.
tadabhyāsāt parasaṃvittilābhaḥ — from its practice, gain of supreme-consciousness.
kādau mānte sācke anacke vā — examples: kā, mā-end, sācke, anacke.
samayānapekṣitvāt paripūrṇaḥ — from disregard-of-convention, complete.
ekīkṛtahṛtkaṇṭhoṣṭho dvādaśāntadvayaṃ hṛdayaṃ ca ekīkuryāt — unified heart-throat-lips, twelve-end-pair and heart let him unify.
iti varṇarahasyam — letter-secret.
tsa-a05-v37.inference: The letter's dhvani is avyaktānukṛti-prāya; practice in the bīja gives parasaṃvitti; the method unifies hṛt-kaṇṭha-oṣṭha + dvāsaśānta-dvaya + hṛdaya — varṇa-rahasya.

tsa-a05-v38.speaker: Teacher (dhyāna-uccāra-varṇa doctrine)
tsa-a05-v38.question: What do some say about the varṇa?
premises: antaḥsparśadvimarśānantarasamudbhūtaṃ sitapītādyāntaraṃ varṇam — white-yellow-and-rest inner letter born after inner-touch-contemplation.
udbhāvyamānaṃ saṃvidam anubhāvayati — being manifested, consciousness causes to experience.
iti kecit — so some.
tsa-a05-v38.inference: A minority view (kecit): the inner varṇa manifests white/yellow etc. as saṃvid-experience — recorded, not adopted.

tsa-a05-v39.speaker: Teacher (dhyāna-uccāra-varṇa doctrine)
tsa-a05-v39.question: What conditions the spanda without vācya?
premises: vācyaviraheṇa saṃvitspandāt — from consciousness-pulsation in absence of expressible.
indvarkagatinirodhābhyām — by moon-sun-motion checks.
tsa-a05-v39.inference: Without expressible content, the spanda runs on indv-arka-gati-nirodha: two checked motions.

tsa-a05-v40.speaker: Teacher (dhyāna-uccāra-varṇa doctrine)
tsa-a05-v40.question: What completes the cid-bīja varṇa?
premises: yasya tu samasaṃpraveśāt — by equal entry of which.
pūrṇāṃ cidbījapiṇḍavarṇavidhau — complete in consciousness-seed-mass-letter-form.
tsa-a05-v40.inference: Equal entry (sama-saṃpraveśa) yields the pūrṇā cid-bīja-piṇḍa-varṇa-vidhā.

tsa-a05-v41.speaker: Teacher (dhyāna-uccāra-varṇa doctrine)
tsa-a05-v41.question: What closes the inner material?
premises: iti āntaraślokaḥ — this is the inner-verse.

tsa-a05-v42.speaker: Teacher (dhyāna-uccāra-varṇa doctrine)
tsa-a05-v42.question: What section ends?
premises: iti varṇavidhiḥ — thus letter-rule.

tsa-a05-v43.speaker: Teacher (dhyāna-uccāra-varṇa doctrine)
tsa-a05-v43.question: What comes next?
premises: karaṇaṃ tu mudrāprakāśane vakṣyāmaḥ — the operation of mudrā-revelation we will say.
tsa-a05-v43.inference: Forward reference: mudrā-prakāśana is the next topic — aṇava/mudrā operation.

tsa-a05-v01.plain_english: When the concept can impress the self by itself, independent of other means — fallen from bonded activity, by the grace of pure knowledge, having attained the form of the Lord's power, relied on as the means, it brings forth śākta knowledge.
tsa-a05-v01.sanskrit_cite: tatra yadā vikalpaḥ svayam eva saṃskāram ātmani upāyāntaranirapekṣatayaiva kartuṃ prabhavati tadā asau pāśavavyāpārāt pracyutaḥ śuddhavidyānugraheṇa parameśaśaktirūpatām āpanna upāyatayā avalambyamānaḥ śāktaṃ jñānam āvirbhāvayati

tsa-a05-v02.plain_english: This is settled in the very next ahnika.
tsa-a05-v02.sanskrit_cite: tad etac ca nirṇītam anantara eva āhnike

tsa-a05-v03.plain_english: But when the concept depends on another means for its own impression — taking mind, breath, body, pots and the rest, limited in form, as means, reaching subtlety — it brings forth āṇava knowledge. Therein the mind is meditation-natured; the breath, gross and subtle — the first, articulation-natured; articulation, moreover, means the five functions beginning with breath; the subtle is denoted by letter-sound, to be said later; the body, arrangement-specific in nature, is denoted by instrument-sound; pots and the rest are external, to be praised as means by pit-pot-liṅga-worship and the rest.
tsa-a05-v03.sanskrit_cite: yadā tu upāyāntaram asau svasaṃskārārthaṃ vikalpo 'pekṣate tadā buddhiprāṇadehaghaṭādikān parimitarūpān upāyatvena gṛhṇan aṇutvaṃ prāpta āṇavaṃ jñānam āvirbhāvayati tatra buddhiḥ dhyānātmikā prāṇaḥ sthūlaḥ sūkṣmaś ca ādya uccāraṇātmā uccāraṇaṃ ca nāma pañca prāṇādyā vṛttayaḥ sūkṣmas tu varṇaśabdavācyo vakṣyate dehaḥ saṃniveśaviśeṣātmā karaṇaśabdavācyaḥ ghaṭādayo bāhyāḥ kumbhasthaṇḍilaliṅgapūjādyupāyatayā kīrtayiṣyamāṇāḥ

tsa-a05-v04.plain_english: Here the fitting meditation is to be taught: that self-luminous supreme tattva, contained in all tattvas — having meditated it in the knowledge of one's own heart, let him meditate there the union of knower, instrument and known, the triad of fire, sun and moon, until he becomes the great Bhairava-fire, fanned by the wind of meditation. From that wheel, wrapped in the twelve old power-flames, having emerged through some pore-door, let him contemplate it resting outside in the graspable self; and by that one at rest, let him meditate how the external is first filled by moon-form in the order of creation, then lit by sun-form in preservation, then dissolved by the fire-form of dissolution, then made unsurpassable-selfhood.
tsa-a05-v04.sanskrit_cite: tatra dhyānaṃ tāvat iha ucitam upadekṣyāmaḥ yat etat svaprakāśaṃ sarvatattvāntarbhūtaṃ paraṃ tattvam uktaṃ tad eva nijahṛdayabodhe dhyātvā tatra pramātṛpramāṇaprameyarūpasya vahnyarkasomatritayasya saṃghaṭṭaṃ dhyāyet yāvat asau mahābhairavāgniḥ dhyānavātasamiddhākāraḥ sampadyate tasya prāktanaśaktijvālādvādaśakaparivṛtasya cakrātmanaḥ cakṣurādīnām anyatamasuṣiradvāreṇa niḥsṛtasya bāhye grāhyātmani viśrāntaṃ cintayet tena ca viśrāntena prathamaṃ tadbāhyaṃ somarūpatayā sṛṣṭikrameṇa prapūritaṃ tataḥ arkarūpatayā sthityā avabhāsitaṃ tato 'pi saṃhāravahnirūpatayā vilāpitaṃ tataḥ anuttarātmatām āpāditaṃ dhyāyet

tsa-a05-v05.plain_english: Thus that wheel becomes complete with all divisions of external things.

tsa-a05-v06.plain_english: Then with that wheel let him meditate the residual habit-states, made thus.
tsa-a05-v06.sanskrit_cite: tato vāsanāśeṣān api bhāvān tena cakreṇa itthaṃ kṛtān dhyāyet

tsa-a05-v07.plain_english: For this unceasing meditator, who determines from his own consciousness the real series of creation, preservation and dissolution — consciousness-merely-real — and the supremacy of creation's autonomy, at once comes the Bhairava-state.
tsa-a05-v07.sanskrit_cite: evam asya anavarataṃ dhyāyinaḥ svasaṃvinmātraparamārthān sṛṣṭisthitisaṃhāraprabandhān sṛṣṭyādisvātantryaparamārthatvaṃ ca svasaṃvido niścinvataḥ sadya eva bhairavībhāvaḥ

tsa-a05-v08.plain_english: By practice, all desired attainments and the rest as well.

tsa-a05-v09.plain_english: The self-luminous all-self-tattva, the triad beginning with measure.

tsa-a05-v10.plain_english: Having entered within, standing, let him meditate in the abode of heart-bliss.

tsa-a05-v12.plain_english: Emerging by ethers outside, let him meditate it bearing the states beginning with creation.

tsa-a05-v13.plain_english: That mandala swallowing all outer and inner being — in the self.

tsa-a05-v14.plain_english: Resting, let the yogin contemplate — thus is the spread of the self.
tsa-a05-v14.sanskrit_cite: viśrāmyan bhāvayed yogī syād evam ātmanaḥ prathā

tsa-a05-v17.plain_english: When about to articulate the breath: first he rests in the emptiness of the heart; then outside, from the arising of breath; then also toward the external, by the moon-filling of apāna, seeing all-selfness; then he becomes desiring no other; then from the arising of samāna he experiences union-rest; then from the arising of the udāna-fire he grasps the construction of measure and measured.
tsa-a05-v17.sanskrit_cite: tatra prāṇam uccicārayiṣuḥ pūrvaṃ hṛdaya eva śūnye viśrāmyati tato bāhye prāṇodayāt tato 'pi bāhyaṃ prati apānacandrāpūraṇena sarvātmatāṃ paśyati tataḥ anyanirākāṅkṣo bhavati tataḥ samānodayāt saṃghaṭṭaviśrāntim anubhavati tata udānavahnyudaye mātṛmeyādikalanāṃ grasate

tsa-a05-v18.plain_english: In the pacification of its swallowing-fire, at the arising of vyāna, devoid of every limitation, it flashes.

tsa-a05-v19.plain_english: Thus from emptiness up to vyāna: these rests — own-bliss, blisslessness, supreme-bliss, brahman-bliss, great-bliss, consciousness-bliss — six bliss-levels are taught; of which one is the connector, without arising or setting, inner-rest-truth-natured: world-bliss.
tsa-a05-v19.sanskrit_cite: evaṃ śūnyāt prabhṛti vyānāntaṃ yā etā viśrāntayaḥ tā eva nijānando nirānandaḥ parānando brahmānando mahānandaḥ cidānanda iti ṣaṭ ānandabhūmaya upadiṣṭāḥ yāsām ekaḥ anusaṃdhātā udayāstamayavihīnaḥ antarviśrāntiparamārtharūpo jagadānandaḥ

tsa-a05-v20.plain_english: Therefore in these articulation-levels, resting each separately two-wise or wholly, he makes the rest-tattva attainable, distinct from that body, breath and the rest.
tsa-a05-v20.sanskrit_cite: tat etāsu uccārabhūmiṣu pratyekaṃ dvyādiśaḥ sarvaśo vā viśrāmya anyat taddehaprāṇādivyatiriktaṃ viśrāntitattvam āsādayati

tsa-a05-v21.plain_english: Keeping in mind that very secret of the articulation of the creation-dissolution seed, let him impress the concept; and in these rests, each separately, five states become, from the depth of entry.
tsa-a05-v21.sanskrit_cite: tad eva sṛṣṭisaṃhārabījoccāraṇarahasyam anusaṃdadhat vikalpaṃ saṃskuryāt āsu ca viśrāntiṣu pratyekaṃ pañca avasthā bhavanti praveśatāratamyāt

tsa-a05-v22.plain_english: Therein first bliss, from contact with the portion of fullness; then arising, a moment, in the embodimentlessness of the habitual; then tremor, from self-power overpowering, loosening body-identity; then sleep, from the dissolution of outwardness.
tsa-a05-v22.sanskrit_cite: tatra prāg ānandaḥ pūrṇatāṃśasparśāt tata udbhavaḥ kṣaṇaṃ niḥśarīratāyāṃ rūḍheḥ tataḥ kampaḥ svabalākrāntau dehatādātmyaśaithilyāt tato nidrā bahirmukhatvavilayāt

tsa-a05-v23.plain_english: Thus, the non-self-being dissolved into self-being: from the all-pervasiveness of the self, the non-self-being dissolves in the self — therefore whirling, from the arising of great pervasion.
tsa-a05-v23.sanskrit_cite: ittham anātmani ātmabhāve līne svātmanaḥ sarvamayatvāt ātmani anātmabhāvo vilīyate iti ato ghūrṇiḥ mahāvyāptyudayāt

tsa-a05-v24.plain_english: These are the levels beginning with waking, up to the limit beyond the fourth.

tsa-a05-v25.plain_english: And these levels occur in the entry of the triangle-root-heart-pace-upward-kuṇḍalinī-wheel.

tsa-a05-v26.plain_english: Thus in articulation-rest: what is supreme pulsation, the knowable dissolved into rest; what is dawning knowable; what is already-dawned knowable — that triad of marks we will say at the proper time.
tsa-a05-v26.sanskrit_cite: evam uccāraviśrāntau yat paraṃ spandanaṃ galitāśeṣavedyaṃ yac ca unmiṣad vedyaṃ yac ca unmiṣitavedyaṃ tad eva liṅgatrayam iti vakṣyāmaḥ svāvasare

tsa-a05-v27.plain_english: And the supreme mark here is the yogini-heart.

tsa-a05-v28.plain_english: Therein the primary pulsation-form, by contraction-and-expansion nature, arising as pair-form, from gaining the rest of the visarga-portion — enough.
tsa-a05-v28.sanskrit_cite: tatra mukhyā spandanarūpatā saṃkocavikāsātmatayā yāmalarūpatodayena visargakalāviśrāntilābhāt ity alam

tsa-a05-v30.plain_english: First in self-knowing, then resting in the knowable, let him complete the knowable.
tsa-a05-v30.sanskrit_cite: pūrvaṃ svabodhe tadanu prameye viśramya meyaṃ paripūrayeta

tsa-a05-v31.plain_english: In the complete, here he rests — the distinction of measurer and measured; quickly let him withdraw.
tsa-a05-v31.sanskrit_cite: pūrṇe 'tra viśrāmyati mātṛmeyavibhāgam āśv eva sa saṃhareta

tsa-a05-v32.plain_english: Having pervaded, then he rests; those would be, together with emptiness, the six means-levels.
tsa-a05-v32.sanskrit_cite: vyāptyātha viśrāmyati tā imāḥ syuḥ śūnyena sākaṃ ṣaḍupāyabhūmyaḥ

tsa-a05-v33.plain_english: Breath and the rest are not-after-vyāna; and dissolved in it, the manifestation beginning with waking.
tsa-a05-v33.sanskrit_cite: prāṇādayo vyānanapaścimās tallīnaś ca jāgrat prabhṛti prapañcaḥ

tsa-a05-v34.plain_english: Established in practice here, in the abode of creation-dissolution contemplation, let him grow before long.

tsa-a05-v37.plain_english: In this articulation flashes a sound, a letter, almost an imitation of the unmanifest; its primary form is in the creation-dissolution seed — from its practice comes the gain of supreme-consciousness. For instance: in kā, at the end of mā, in sācke, in anacke, or articulated within, remembered — the touch of consciousness-pulsation, equally distinguished, complete because it disregards convention; even for those who regard convention, words producing its meaning like a mirage and the rest; from the touch of unsurpassable consciousness, let him unify the heart-throat-lips, the pair of twelve-ends and the heart — the letter-secret.
tsa-a05-v37.sanskrit_cite: asmin eva uccāre sphuran avyaktānukṛtiprāyo dhvaniḥ varṇaḥ tasya sṛṣṭisaṃhārabīje mukhyaṃ rūpaṃ tadabhyāsāt parasaṃvittilābhaḥ tathāhi kādau mānte sācke anacke vā antaruccārite smṛte vā samaviśiṣṭaḥ saṃvitspandasparśaḥ samayānapekṣitvāt paripūrṇaḥ samayopekṣiṇo 'pi śabdāḥ tadarthabhāvakā manorājyādivat anuttarasaṃvitsparśāt ekīkṛtahṛtkaṇṭhoṣṭho dvādaśāntadvayaṃ hṛdayaṃ ca ekīkuryāt iti varṇarahasyam

tsa-a05-v38.plain_english: The white-yellow-and-rest inner letter, born immediately after the contemplation of inner touch, being manifested, causes consciousness to be experienced — so some say.
tsa-a05-v38.sanskrit_cite: antaḥsparśadvimarśānantarasamudbhūtaṃ sitapītādyāntaraṃ varṇam udbhāvyamānaṃ saṃvidam anubhāvayati iti kecit

tsa-a05-v39.plain_english: By the absence of the expressible, from consciousness-pulsation, by the two checks of moon-and-sun motion.

tsa-a05-v40.plain_english: Of which, by equal entry, complete in the form of the consciousness-seed-mass letter.

tsa-a05-v43.plain_english: The operation of mudrā-revelation we will say.

Practice-established grows before long in the creation-dissolution contemplation-abode. Inner-verses close the inner section. Articulation section ends. Flashing letter almost-imitating-unmanifest: primary in creation-dissolution-seed; its practice gains supreme-consciousness; unify heart-throat-lips, twelve-end-pair, heart — letter-secret. Some say: white-yellow inner letter born after inner-touch-contemplation manifests consciousness-experience. Without expressible: consciousness-pulsation runs on moon-sun-motion checks. Equal entry completes the consciousness-seed-mass letter-form. Inner-verse closes. Letter-rule section ends. Mudrā-revelation operation comes next.
sections.FUNCTION: Teaches the three upāya-knowledge types (śākta/āṇava via vikalpa), the heart-dhyāna with its four-fillings, the six-stage prāṇa-uccāra through six bliss-levels, the five avasthās per rest, and the varṇa-rahasya of uccāra — closing with the mudrā forward-reference.
sections.KEY TERMS: vikalpa as upāya (self-impressing concept); śākta/āṇava jñāna (power-form vs instrument-form knowledge); mahābhairavāgni (meditation-fanned fire); catur-viśrānti (moon/sun/fire/anuttara fillings); ṣaḍ-ānanda-bhūmi (six bliss-levels + jagad-ānanda connector); pañca-avasthā per viśrānti (ānanda→ghūrṇi); liṅga-traya (spandana/ unmiṣat/ unmiṣita); varṇa-rahasya (avyaktānukṛti-dhvani, hṛt-kaṇṭha-oṣṭha unification).
sections.LOCAL CONTEXT: Āhnika 5 bridges dhyāna (u1-16) → uccāraṇa (u17-36) → varṇa-vidhi (u37-42); the mudrā forward-ref (u43) opens ahnika 6; v2's 'next ahnika' closes the vikalpa-knowledge question posed in a04.
sections.BOUNDARY: Five avasthās per rest asserted with only four named here (fifth arrives u23); kecit white/yellow-varṇa view recorded not adopted; samaya-neglect 'complete' stated without which conventions are meant; liṅga-traya deferred to 'proper time' — never resolved here.
sections.EXPLANATION: The ahnika runs: knowledge-types by vikalpa-dependence → the heart-dhyāna (triadic union + four cosmic fillings) → practice-results and the placed triad → breath-articulation in six stages yielding six bliss-levels → five states per rest (ānanda to ghūrṇi) → the liṅga-traya and primary spanda → completion-order (svabodha→meya) → the letter's dhvani and its unification method. Each section closes with its own colophon (dhyāna/uccāraṇa/varṇa-vidhi).

throat-lips, the pair of twelve-ends, and heart —

root-heart's upward kuṇḍalinī-wheel is entered.
So in articulation-rest: the supreme pulsation,
knowable-dissolved-in-rest; the dawning knowable;
the already-dawned — that triad of marks we will
tell at the right time.

creation-dissolution contemplation, let him grow
before long.
Inner-verses: these.
Articulation ends here.
In this articulation flashes a sound-letter,
almost imitation of the unmanifest; its primary form
is in the creation-dissolution seed — from its
practice, gain of supreme-consciousness. For instance:
in kā, at mā's end, in sācke, in anacke, or
articulated within, remembered — the touch of
consciousness-pulsation, equally distinguished,
complete in disregard of convention; even for those
who keep convention, words that make its meaning,
like mirage and the rest; from the touch of
unsurpassable consciousness, let him unify heart-
throat-lips, the pair of twelve-ends, and heart —
the letter-secret.

pulsation — by moon-and-sun motion's two checks.

The operation of mudrā-revelation
